page.overview:
Who is Coelurosaurus?

"Coelurosaurus" is a small, herbivorous dinosaur mentioned within the novel Jurassic Park. While it's true identity remains unknown, it has been suggested to be a misspelling of either Coelurus or [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%22Coelosaurus%22_antiquus Coelosaurus] and a mistaken name by Henry Wu, as he said he wasn't sure that was correct.

Coelurosaurus is described to be a small herbivore by Dr. Henry Wu, but aside from that, there is next-to-no other information given about it. It is commonly theorised to be a mistranslation of Coelurus, a small carnivorous theropod from the Morrison Formation. There are several reasons why this may be the case; the first of which is that Coelurus was present at a fossil formation that InGen was sending expeditions to, meaning that there is a high chance that InGen might have collected their DNA. Coelurus is also present within the film franchise, much like several other novel species. Additionally, of the two most likely candidates behind Coelurusaurus' identity, Coelurus is the only valid one, as [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%22Coelosaurus%22_antiquus Coelosaurus] is considered a dubious Ornithomimid. However, the description of "small herbivore" best fits Coelosaurus. It always possible, however, that "coelurosaurus" could refer to any coelurosaur, as coelurosaurs are the clade containing all Megaraptorans, Tyrannosauroids, Ornithomimosaurs, Maniraptorans (including birds).

Sometime prior to 1989, DNA presumed to belong to a "Coelurosaurus" was acquired by InGen, and the animal was planned to be cloned for Jurassic Park on Isla Nublar. An egg designated as "xxxx-0001/1" being shown to the Endorsement Team by Dr Henry Wu shortly before the incident on the island. It is unknown if the egg hatched before the island was abandoned. However, even if it did, all dinosaurs on Isla Nublar were killed off during the Costa Rican Napalm Strike several hours later.
